summary.text: Paul Irving Jones is the Republican candidate for California State Assembly District 62 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Jose Solache (D).
He also ran for the seat in 2024 and for U.S. House California District 44 in 2022.

paragraphs.text: Paul Irving Jones was the Republican candidate in the November 8, 2022 general election for U.S. House California District 44, where incumbent Nanette Barragan defeated him, 72.2 percent to 27.8 percent.
In 2024 he was the Republican candidate for the open Assembly District 62 seat and lost the general election to Jose Solache, 66.0 percent to 34.0 percent.
Jones advanced from the June 2, 2026 primary alongside Solache, who now holds the seat.
